|----------|-------|-----------|-------|
| Google Gemini | gemini-2.5-pro | yes | RPD 100 |
| Google Gemini | gemini-2.5-flash | yes | RPD 1500 |
| Groq | llama-3.3-70b-versatile | yes | RPD 1000 |
| Groq | gemma2-9b-it | yes | RPD 14400 |
| Cerebras | qwen-3-coder-480b | yes | 60k TPM |
| Mistral AI | mistral-large-latest | yes | Experiments tier |
| OpenRouter | `meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct:free` | yes | gateway |
| Unknown-Provider | something | yes | should be ignored |
